part.text: The bug is in `getFieldQuery(String, String, int)` at line 90-97: the boost wraps the query in a `BoostQuery` *before* `applySlop` is called, so `applySlop` no longer sees a `PhraseQuery`/`MultiPhraseQuery` and the slop is dropped. The fix is to apply slop before the boost.

part.text:
Fixed. In `MultiFieldQueryParser.getFieldQuery(String, String, int)` (lucene/queryparser/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/classic/MultiFieldQueryParser.java:97), the field query was wrapped in a `BoostQuery` before `applySlop` was called, so `applySlop` no longer recognized the `PhraseQuery`/`MultiPhraseQuery` and silently dropped the slop. The fix applies slop before the boost, matching the no-boost code path.

Validated by temporarily patching the MR-JAR build config to skip the Java-19 sources (offline, no JDK 19 toolchain available), running `./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:test` — all 12 `TestMultiFieldQueryParser` tests (including the boost-with-slop case) and the full queryparser suite passed. The temporary build change was reverted; the working tree now contains only the one-line-ordering fix.
